A '''gription panel''', also known as a '''magnatomic grip panel''', was a panel of [[gription]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. By using normal friction and special materials, gription panels held the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against their [[Body glove/Legends|body gloves]]. By depressing certain sections of the panel, a gription panel could be released, allowing the trooper to remove his armor.
